what_happened: Limited-run pop-up in New York before the brand's first permanent US stores.
results_and_next_move: Followed by a permanent store in Santa Fe (July 2017, year inferred from the article) and a Los Angeles flagship that opened on 21 July 2018.

what_happened: Exclusive pieces teased for the Los Angeles flagship opening: a camo hat, a camo bag, a bomber jacket, a vest and a coat. The store also carries the seasonal line, Indigo Camping Trailer and WMV.
